title: Intervention-Robust VLA: Diverse Demonstrations for Robot Deployment with Safety Filters
abstract: arXiv:2611.28289v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have shown strong potential for learning complex robotic behaviors from demonstrations. However, learning safe behavior directly from data requires extensive coverage of safety-critical situations, which is often impractical in real-world settings. Test-time safety filters provide an alternative by correcting unsafe actions during deployment, but these interventions can drive the robot into states poorly covered by the training data, thereby degrading task performance. We introduce InteR-VLA, an intervention-robust framework for VLAs that leverages diverse task-completing demonstrations to broaden task-relevant state coverage and maintain competence under safety interventions. By better aligning the training distribution with safety-filtered deployment under the same data budget, our approach mitigates intervention-induced distribution shift while preserving task performance. Real-world experiments

translated_title: 干预鲁棒的VLA：利用多样化示范实现带安全过滤器的机器人部署
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在从示范中学习复杂机器人行为方面展现了强大的潜力。然而，直接从数据中学习安全行为需要对安全关键情况进行广泛覆盖，这在真实环境中往往不切实际。测试时安全过滤器提供了一种替代方案，通过在部署过程中纠正不安全动作来保障安全，但这些干预可能会使机器人进入训练数据覆盖不足的状态，从而降低任务性能。我们提出了InteR-VLA，这是一个面向VLA的干预鲁棒框架，它利用多样化的任务完成示范来扩大与任务相关的状态覆盖范围，并在安全干预下保持任务能力。通过在相同数据预算下更好地对齐训练分布与安全过滤后的部署分布，我们的方法减轻了干预引起的分布偏移，同时保持了任务性能。真实世界实验验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 提出InteR-VLA框架，通过利用多样化的任务完成示范扩大任务相关状态的覆盖范围，使VLA模型在安全过滤器干预部署时仍能保持良好的任务性能。
en_tdlr: InteR-VLA is an intervention-robust framework that leverages diverse task-completing demonstrations to broaden task-relevant state coverage, enabling VLAs to maintain task performance under safety-filter interventions during deployment.
